decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a recent launch with unresolved market value, and it builds on the firm's established automation offer, so keeping it costs little relative to its option value amid growing demand for automated precast production.

The automatic de-shuttering robot overlaps somewhat with the combined robot, which raises the chance of consolidation, but after only one year its uncertainty has not resolved and carrying it is cheap because it shares the platform.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in an integrated line and adds coordinated system value, so the option is worth keeping while customer uptake is still unclear.

The automatic shuttering robot is a core automation module with low incremental carrying cost and no negative evidence yet, so keeping it preserves upside despite some overlap with the combined robot.
